title: Language Indicator on Encoded Pairs
statement: For every Boolean mode, bit string $z$, and natural number $q$, the Boolean indicator of the language that tests whether $q$ is less than the length of $dropIdx(z)$ in length mode, and otherwise tests whether the bit of $dropIdx(z)$ at position $q$ is true, evaluated on $\langle z,\mathrm{bits}(q)\rangle$, equals true or false according to that same test.
